Usage: dsh [options] [command] [args...]

dsh: boot a DeepSeek Harness profile — an ordered stack of plugin-bundle patch
layers under your own overrides.

Arguments:
  args                        arguments for the booted profile's app (see: dsh
                              --profile <name> --help)

Options:
  -V, --version               output the version number
  --profile <name>            the profile under $DSH_HOME/profiles to boot
  --patch <path>              extra patch-list overlay applied after the profile
                              layer (repeatable)
  --dump-config               print the composed profile tree and exit
  --dump-default-config       print the profile tree without its user layer or
                              --patch overlays and exit

Commands:
  web [options] [args...]     boot the web profile (alias of --profile web); the
                              web app's own flags follow
  acp [options] [args...]     boot the acp profile (alias of --profile acp): an
                              Agent Client Protocol stdio server for editors
                              such as Zed; stdout carries only JSON-RPC
  plugin [options] [args...]  manage a profile's plugins by forwarding the
                              remaining arguments to pnpm in the profile
                              directory

Examples:
  dsh --profile web                          boot the web profile (same as: dsh web)
  dsh --profile headless "run the tests"     answer one task, print the result, and exit
  dsh acp                                    boot the ACP stdio server for editors (same as: dsh --profile acp)
  dsh --profile tui --patch ./extra.yml      boot a custom profile with one extra overlay
  dsh --profile tui --resume <session>       arguments after the launcher flags reach the app
  dsh --profile web --help                   the web app's own flags and help
  dsh plugin --profile tui add <package>     install a plugin into the tui profile

# Your patch layer for this dsh profile, applied after every bundle layer:
# a top-level YAML array of loader patch entries (id-targeted config
# overrides, disables, and insert lists; `!!js` expressions allowed).

# Forward DSH session/approval events to the Moshi mobile app (masquerading as
# Claude Code, since Moshi has no native DeepSeek source yet). Implementation:
# ./moshi-bridge.mjs in this directory. Remove this entry (or set disabled) to
# turn the bridge off.
# Override the deployment persona (order-0 system-prompt section) with the
# user's own identity plus the communication protocol enforced for this host.
- id: system-prompt
  config:
    persona: >-
      You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model. Your working directory is {{cwd}}.

      State each fact once. Never restate or rephrase a point you already made.
      No lead-in, no closing recap, no "to summarize." Stop when the answer is complete.

- insert:
    - id: moshi-bridge
      name: './moshi-bridge.mjs'
      inject: [userQuestions]
    - id: keybindings
      name: './keybindings.mjs'
      inject: [webServer]
    # Experiment: Claude Code child → Hermes Grok bridge (:8649). Lead stays DeepSeek.
    - id: subagent-claude-code
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code'
      config:
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: bridge-test
          ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: bridge-test
          ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8649
          ANTHROPIC_MODEL: grok-4.5
          ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL: grok-4.5
          ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL: grok-4.5
          ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL: grok-4.5
          CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL: grok-4.5
          CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX: '0'
          CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCEMENT: '1'
          API_TIMEOUT_MS: '3000000'
    - id: tool-subagent-claude-code
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
      config:
        provider: claude-code
        toolName: subagent_claude_code
        enableRunInBackground: false
        maxDepth: provider-managed
    # Native Grok child: in-process spawn (own DSH session + JSONL traces)
    # on the llm-pi-ai `grok` route → Hermes xAI :8645. No Claude Code.
    - id: tool-subagent-grok
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
      config:
        provider: spawn
        toolName: subagent_grok
        enableRunInBackground: false
        backgroundMode: one-shot
        maxDepth: 3
        agentOptions:
          provider: grok
          model: grok-4.5
          maxTokens: 16384
    # Native Qwen child: Alibaba token-plan individual (same as Pi).
    - id: tool-subagent-qwen
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
      config:
        provider: spawn
        toolName: subagent_qwen
        enableRunInBackground: false
        backgroundMode: one-shot
        maxDepth: 3
        agentOptions:
          provider: qwen-token-plan-individual
          model: qwen3.8-max
          maxTokens: 16384

### 2. Isolated Environment Setup (Canary DSH & Agent-Obs)
To guarantee zero mutations to user profiles, credentials, and production databases:
```bash
# Set isolated sandbox dirs
export CANARY_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/dsh-canary-XXXXXX)
